title: phalangium milleflorum
intro: Phalangium milleflorum, commonly known as Thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. Thyme has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to boost the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an expectorant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic, making it effective in treating respiratory issues, wounds, and muscle spasms. Thyme contains bioactive constituents such as thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
